findings.rationale: Accepted: selector contract aligned with frozen R2 — --engine and --runner required together, --endpoint optional; omitted endpoint selects the null-endpoint row (same as --endpoint @none), never a wildcard; tests cover both forms (§1, §2.1, §2.6).

Accepted: the endpoint-mismatch negative is relabelled a green-at-base preservation guard; the change-pinning red is the matching-endpoint pin admitting the exact indexed seat; both recorded against the base sha (§2.6).
Superseded by the codex R2 fold: the plan now matches the rubric's optional-endpoint form, so no supersession note is needed.
